_comment: The amalanhig: single fused piece, wide A-pose with the hands clawed, head pushed forward. Symmetric, so the right side is mirrored from the left. Joint positions from tools/blender/slice_model.py and the front and side renders (its own units, 1.0 tall; faces -Y, its left is +X). Torn cloth hangs over the thighs, so the leg joints follow the feet. Used by tools/blender/rig_humanoid.py.
